# Data Source: identitynow_verified_from_address

Use this data source to look up a sender ("From:") email address and its verification status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_verified_from_address" "no_reply" {
  email = "no-reply@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Sender email address, compared case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Sender address ID.
- `is_verified_by_domain` (Boolean) Whether the address is verified by its domain.
- `region` (String) AWS SES region the address is associated with.
- `verification_status` (String) Verification status: `PENDING`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED` or `NA`.
